# Employee shifts fixtures

Live sanitized capture: **2026-10-29** re-check (first captured 2026-10-28),
generated by `tool/shifts_capture.dart`.

- `employee_shifts_list.json` — page 1, pageSize 25, includeInactive=true; 25 rows.
- `employee_shifts_list_filtered.json` — pageSize 5 filtered by employee.
- `employee_shift_detail.json` — assignment 1.
- `employee_shift_not_found.json` — `EMPLOYEE_SHIFT_NOT_FOUND`.
- `employee_shifts_forbidden_employee.json` — `ACCESS_DENIED`.

Observed contract: `employeeShiftId`, `employeeId`, `employeeCode`,
`employeeName`, `shiftId`, `shiftName`, `fromDate`, `toDate`, `startTime`,
`endTime`, `earlyPunchInMinutes`, `lateGraceMinutes`, `statusId/status`,
`timeZoneId`, `punchInOpensAt`, `crossesMidnight`. Employee names/codes are
sanitized; time zones are real IANA ids. Employee and shift selectors use live
`GET /api/employees?pageSize=100&statusId=1` and
`GET /api/shifts?pageSize=100&statusId=1`. Evidence:
`employees/employee_options.json` (34 active employees) and
`shifts/shift_options.json` (22 active shifts). No selector fallback is used.
